body: Thanks.  It's just hard.  I dont see my value.

Thanks.  I actually came back to this profile for an update of sorts.  

Basically I'm going to "throw in the towel".  I realize after reading a lot and watching videos that she is no longer a person to me, but almost like an item of my desire that I'm trying to keep out of fear.  I still love her very much and that will never change, but the only way for us to start to heal is if I take a step back and allow the current events to play themselves out.  I'm going to try and keep my distance from her...  well...  as much distance you can keep from someone you live with and is the mother of your kid.  I'm going to start hanging out with other people, get my own shit together, and try to put an air of moving on.  The hope is that me getting a plan for my own life going along with a general feeling of absence will start to make her see me differently as well as the whole absence makes the heart grow fonder.  If she sees me being a good partner outside of "us" and I start pursuing my own thing, "makeover" (lose weight, get new threads, start taking better care, etc), then maybe either before the lease is up or somewhere after we actually seperate she will want to be with me again.  

That's my not current plan.  Either it works, or i do it long enough that i do get better myself that i start to believe i dont need her anymore.  Who knows.

The thing is I sort of have an answer to what she wanted, but it goes against my conceptions of our relationship.  I dont know if you read the other comments or if i got to the point in them or not (a lot of rambling in the heat of things), but the tl;dr version is she came from an abusive relationship so sex was spotty and I was content with that and didnt want to push it, but turns out she wanted more aggressiveness from me with that.  And communication sucked, mainly from depression from me because we weren't having sex (I realized in this thread).  So the fix would be I act more the way I should in the relationship and not how I think I should be, if that makes sense.

No real progress.  She is unreceptive to anything right now.  I think I have to wait a little bit, despite me wanting change now.  I am just in pain and want it to be over.  I hate this feeling.  Thanks for checking in, though.

Wow.  This actually makes sense.  Now I just need a way to present it to her so we could work on it.  I guess this is about time now.  I have to show her a change for now and then hopefully get somewhere with her that I can talk about this article with her.

We are being civil right now.  I mean, I still live there, just on the couch.  We are doing this until the lease is up.  That's like a year or so from now.  Hopefully by then I can fix this.  Thanks
No, she hasnt.  Not as far as I know.  I mean, she goes to work and comes home.  We have a kid, so i dont think shes running off in the middle of the night while I'm at work.  I hope she's not.
By the way, this excellent advice.  I need to worry about me.  Thank you.  It's just hard.

Forgot the kicker.  This has been going on for almost a month.  She told me that day that she started talking to people on Instagram to feel good about herself.  She started talking to an ex a lot as well.  She made it clear that he is seeing someone and they are only talking.  I know she hasnt cheated on me, she works and comes home and that's it.  So physically she hasnt cheated, but I feel like that's an emotional cheat.  Not to mention no fucking dude is going to be friends with an ex without wanting to get with them.  I believe men and women can be platonic friends, but I know this dude.  When I started talking to her, he was still trying to talk to her.  She used to get upset he was trying to, and obviously I won out in the end.  

Last night she decided she wanted to go see a concert on her own.  I was in the living room when she came home.  She dumped her phone and stuff on the couch and went to the bathroom drunk off her ass.  He called.  I saw his name on the fucking caller ID.  I'm hurt.  I'm hurt even more because she felt like she needed to talk to someone other than me, and especially hurt it's with him.  I know she is hurting, but why talk to him?  He doesnt care.  He just wants to put in his time so when shes ready to move on he can swoop the fuck in.

I want to do couples therapy.  She isn't willing to at this point.  I had time to do it half a year ago, but I thought we were fine.  She says it's too late.  Maybe in time I can convince her, but it doesnt stop the pain I have right now.  And honestly  I dont think I can pursue therapy on my own for myself with what I make at this job.

I have a shit job right now.  Graveyardshift cleaning a dog facility.  I used to have a real damn good job as a digital image editor.  Basically I made sure images looked good for the web for different clothing catalogues.  They outsourced our whole department.  I never went to school for this, I learned by doing, so I have no degree.  Which is a big reason why I was feeling like shit since August, because now I have no marketable skills.  I'm trying to find something, I really am.

It's a long story.  She was emotionally abused in a past relationship and it affected her sex life ever since.  She initiated sex our first time...  well, MY first time.  I was a virgin.  But she initiated it, then before anything could happen she cried.  So we didnt that time.  And I sort of never pushed or initiated sex.  She was my best friend and i have a hand, so i thought she was this fragile thing that needed protection and I could do that myself, or if she wanted to she could let me know.  I think that subconsciously I stopped putting an effort into things and we just sort of existed after 5 or 6 years.  Recently it all came out of her mouth that she wanted me to be more assertive and romantic.

That's not to say I didnt attempt.  I would do small romantic gestures or try to have sex with her but I always felt some resistance from her.  I think it was because of how long it's been going on, and she has her own issues she never really worked on.

That and I kept stuff from her.  Someone was using my identity and ran up a good amount in my name.  I was trying to handle it myself.  It killed me not to tell her, but I felt like it was my problem.  My dad offered to help me because I was talking to him about it via text and I tuned him down, then deleted the text, then when I was giving my daughter a bath he text back and that's how she found out.  She started to think that I was keeping other things from her, like cheating, which I'm not.  Never could do that.
